when.quote: Use this process when a customer believes there is a discrepancy between the cash back they received for a particular transaction and the cash back they should have received.

info.about: The customer's full name, email or user id, used to find their record
info.ask: Could you give me your full name so I can find your account?

info.about: Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, home address. They must match the records
info.ask: To verify your identity, please give me two of these: your date of birth, email, phone number or home address.

info.about: The verified customer's Rho-Bank user id
The customer's cards and card types, for example Gold Rewards Card or EcoCard
Each credit card transaction: transaction_id, card type, merchant, amount, category and rewards_earned in points
The transactions whose recorded rewards differ from the correctly calculated rewards. The agent finds these in the records because the customer may not know them

steps.do: Greet the customer and ask what they need help with
Find the customer's record using the name, email or user id they gave

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email / get_user_information_by_id)

steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Ask for 2 of: DOB, email, phone, address. Check them against the record. Share no account details before this check passes
steps.quote: Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log
steps.if: the customer gave 2 values that match
steps.quote: If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.
After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Get the customer's credit card accounts and card types
steps.quote: Our customer service team has the tools to investigate cash back discrepancies and review your transaction history.

steps.do: Get all of the customer's credit card transactions
steps.quote: When you contact us, we'll look into the specific transaction, verify the merchant category, check the applicable reward rates for your card, and determine if an adjustment is needed.

steps.do: For every transaction, work out the correct points from the card rate and category, rounding down. Compare the result with the recorded rewards_earned and list each transaction that does not match
steps.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number.

steps.do: Tell the customer which transactions were under-credited or mis-credited (merchant, amount, recorded vs correct rewards) and give each transaction_id. Do not ask for receipts
steps.quote: Confirm the customer has the correct transaction_id before they submit.

steps.do: Give the customer the cash back dispute tool
steps.if: at least one transaction has incorrect rewards
steps.quote: Tool to provide to the user: `submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id: str, transaction_id: str)`

steps.do: Tell the customer to run the tool once for each wrong transaction, using their own user_id and that transaction_id. Say that more context may be asked for later during review
steps.quote: Tell the customer to run the tool with their own user_id and the specific transaction_id for the purchase in question.

steps.do: Customer submits one dispute for each wrong transaction
steps.quote: Instead of a step-by-step workflow, instruct the customer to use the tool directly:

steps.if: the dispute is shown as resolved and approved
steps.quote: Use `unlock_discoverable_agent_tool` to unlock the agent tool `update_transaction_rewards_3847`.

steps.do: Write the independently recalculated whole-number points to each resolved transaction

args.new_rewards_earned: 'X points' where X is the recalculated whole-number value

steps.if: the dispute is shown as resolved and approved
steps.quote: After a cash back dispute is resolved and approved, you must update the affected transaction(s) with the correct rewards value.

steps.do: Re-read the transactions to confirm the corrected rewards now show
steps.quote: Confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history after the tool call completes.

steps.do: Summarize which transactions were disputed or corrected, then ask if the customer needs anything else
steps.quote: If we find that you were indeed shortchanged on your rewards, we'll make sure the correct amount is applied to your account.

rules.rule: Rewards are stored as points. For cash back cards, 1 point = $0.01, so points = amount x cash back % x 100
rules.quote: For example, 250 points equals $2.50 in cash back, which matches a 2.5% cash back rate on a $100 purchase.

rules.rule: Gold Rewards Card: 2.5% cash back on all purchases, so correct points = floor(amount x 2.5)
rules.quote: Earn 2.5% cash back on all purchases.

rules.rule: EcoCard earns sustainability points: 5 per dollar on green purchases and 1 per dollar on other purchases
rules.quote: The only true points-based card is the EcoCard, which earns 'sustainability points' (5 points per dollar on green purchases, 1 point per dollar on other purchases)

rules.rule: The Green and Sustainable categories mean the same thing and are the green category for EcoCard
EcoCard purchases at Target, Walmart, Amazon (including Amazon-processed marketplace orders) and ThredUp earn only 1 point per dollar, even for eco products
rules.quote: EcoCard purchases at the retailers listed above earn the standard rate of $1.00 point per dollar, not the higher $5.00 points per dollar.

rules.rule: EcoCard EV charging earns 5 points per dollar only at Tesla Supercharger, ChargePoint or EVgo. Other networks earn 1 point per dollar
rules.quote: EV charging only qualifies for green rewards when using one of our 3 certified partner charging networks: Tesla Supercharger, ChargePoint, or EVgo.

rules.rule: Always round points down (floor of amount x rate). Never round to the nearest number
rules.quote: Similarly, a $99.99 purchase at 2.5% cash back would calculate to 249.975 points but would award 249 points.

rules.rule: Recalculate rewards yourself. Never trust an expected_rewards field
rules.quote: Important: Do not rely on any expected_rewards field in the dispute record. Independently verify rates and eligibility.

rules.rule: new_rewards_earned must be the string 'X points' with X a whole number
rules.quote: new_rewards_earned: a string formatted as 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value

rules.rule: The customer files the dispute, one transaction_id per call. The agent does not file it and collects no card details
rules.quote: Do not collect sensitive card details; the tool uses the identifiers provided by the user.

rules.rule: Do not ask for receipts or documents. No procedure for handling them exists here
rules.quote: Do not ask for any documentation, receipts... from the customer unless it states very clearly in the knowledge base how to process it, and whether you're allowed to do so.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged. Every transaction has been recalculated. The customer has submitted submit_cash_back_dispute_0589 once for each transaction with wrong rewards. If a dispute shows as resolved and approved, update_transaction_rewards_3847 has written the correct 'X points' value and the change was confirmed. The customer has had a summary.

documents.why: Internal procedure for submitting a cash back dispute: give the customer submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id, transaction_id) and confirm the transaction_id first
Internal procedure for applying corrections after a dispute is resolved: update_transaction_rewards_3847, the 'X points' format, independent recalculation, confirming the update
Rewards are stored as points: cash back cards use 1 point = $0.01, and EcoCard earns 5/1 sustainability points per dollar
Rounding rule: points always round down
Valid rewards categories. Green and Sustainable are the same category
Customer-facing description of a cash back discrepancy investigation: review transactions, merchant category and rates
Gold Rewards Card earns 2.5% cash back on all purchases
Confirms the Gold Rewards Card 2.5% rate on all purchases. No bonus categories
EcoCard earn rates: 5 points per dollar on green, 1 point per dollar on other purchases
What counts as a green purchase for EcoCard
EcoCard exclusions: Target, Walmart, Amazon and ThredUp get the standard rate, and EV charging qualifies only at Tesla Supercharger, ChargePoint or EVgo

open_questions: The agent has no documented read tool for the cash_back_disputes database. It is unclear how to tell that a dispute is 'resolved and approved' before calling update_transaction_rewards_3847. Apply the correction only if the result of submit_cash_back_dispute_0589, or another record, shows the dispute as resolved or approved.
The rounding doc's worked example is inconsistent. Assumed points = floor(amount x points-per-dollar), which matches its $99.99 example (249). For EcoCard: floor(amount x 5) or floor(amount x 1).
No document lists Gold Rewards Card or EcoCard promotions that change per-transaction earn rates. The EcoCard new-customer bonus is a one-time lump sum and does not change per-transaction rewards.
The 'rho_bank_policy' doc id stands for the agent's system policy text (verification, time, receipts). It is not a knowledge-base document.
